verdict.rationale: Token2's tools (fido2-manage CLI/GUI, Companion App, Entra ID bulk-enrollment script) cover one-off key management and provisioning, and nothing in the evidence documents recurring scheduling. The headless watcher that opens the GUI when a key is inserted is an event trigger, not a recurring schedule. The bulk-enrollment script is a one-off action, not a scheduled workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
